scenes.heading: Blank, Logo, Clear
scenes.say: Blank, Logo and Clear. How to keep the screen calm.

scenes.heading: Blank: the full stop
scenes.say: Press the full stop key and the screen goes black at once. Press it again, or choose Show, and the slide comes back where it was.

scenes.heading: Which one?
items: Logo: your church's logo, for gaps
Clear text: hides the words, keeps the picture
scenes.say: Blank puts up black. Logo shows your church's logo, for gaps between items. Clear text, in the More menu, hides the words but keeps the background. Show brings the slide back.
If anything goes wrong, a wrong slide, a typo, anything at all: blank first, then think. Nobody minds a black screen for a moment.

scenes.heading: Try each one
scenes.action: On the sermon deck that comes next
scenes.say: Try each one on the sermon deck that comes next. Press Space to start it.
